crashDetails.MOD_RESOLUTION_CONFLICT: A conflict exists between mod {{param1}} and {{param2}}.

body.text: Welcome to USTBL! Before you start, please be sure to read and agree to our <terms>User Agreement</terms>.

github.title: GitHub
github.description: Accelerate GitHub website, API, and assets

notice.title: Note
notice.description: GitHub websites use the vUSTB proxy. Windows proxy settings change only after connection and authentication succeed; stopping restores your previous settings.

latency.title: Node connectivity
latency.empty: Test the acceleration nodes to view latency.
latency.direct: Test route: direct connection without acceleration

ipv6.title: IPv6 free traffic
ipv6.description: Connect to Cloudflare WARP via IPv6 and forward applications through TUN.
ipv6.administrator: TUN requires administrator permissions. Exit USTBL and run it as administrator.
ipv6.working: Working… Download and startup may take a moment.
ipv6.bypassDescription: One domain or CIDR per line; saved on start. Changes apply after restarting IPv6.
ipv6.nodesDescription: 28 IPv6 endpoints; test latency after starting. An empty delay means no result or unreachable.
ipv6.noticeDescription: Authenticate first on USTB-Student or USTB-V6; USTB_Wi-Fi does not support free IPv6. Requires usable public IPv6. Bypassed traffic follows normal billing. Stops TUN on exit; actual free traffic depends on campus policy.

exportFormat.Modrinth: Smaller package size; required mods are downloaded from a manifest during import.
exportFormat.MultiMC: Widely supported by major launchers; packaged as a complete instance.

error.invalidVersion: Please enter a valid version number
error.noFileSelected: Tick at least one file or set a rule
error.bothVariants: Both the enabled and disabled file of {{path}} exist. Delete one before publishing
error.tooManyRules: At most {{max}} rules are allowed. Set folders instead of single files
error.previousRelease: Could not read the line's previous release, so publishing is paused. Pick the target again or retry later

version.error-2: Version number is too long (max 64 characters)

tree.legend: Include: ships with the version. Ignore: this version leaves it alone and players keep theirs. Delete: removed on players' update. Click the state button to cycle; a folder's state applies to every file under it except those set individually.
tree.onceHint: Placed only when a player first installs; never updated afterwards and not restored if the player deletes it
tree.restoreHint: Drop the setting here and follow the folder above
tree.conflict: Both the enabled and disabled file exist

adoption.keptOther: The instance already follows another modpack or line, so its source record was left alone.
adoption.notIsolated: Version isolation is off for this instance, so it was not linked to this modpack.
adoption.localChanged: The instance does not match the version just published (for example a file marked Delete is still on disk), so it was not linked to it. The next update will handle it from the version's contents.
adoption.recordFailed: The version was published, but the instance could not be linked to it. The next check compares as usual.

started.title: Upload started
started.description: It continues in the background. Follow it on the Downloads page.

error.loaderUnavailable: Mod loader {{loader}} {{version}} is unavailable, cannot install

ignored.file: You ignored changes in this file. Your version is kept by default.
ignored.takeAllNote: Spots you ignored keep your version, even with "Use new version for all".

status.planning: Comparing the new version with local files…
status.applying: Updating the modpack. Do not close the launcher…
status.notFollowing: This instance does not follow a modpack
status.needsRepair: This instance cannot be compared for updates until it is repaired
status.unknown: Could not get update information. Try again later
status.waitingLoader: Waiting for the mod loader to finish installing before checking for updates
status.localChanges: You changed {{count}} file(s) managed by the modpack; the update will ask about each

plan.fastForward: Local files already match {{latest}}; only the recorded version needs syncing
plan.loaderChange: Mod loader will change from {{from}} to {{to}}
plan.conflicts: {{count}} files conflict with local changes. Choose what to do (local is kept by default)
plan.reinstallRequired: {{latest}} changes the modpack's component chain and cannot be applied in place. Install the modpack again

conflictKind.modifiedLocallyChangedRemotely: You edited it and the new version changed it
conflictKind.modifiedLocallyRemovedRemotely: You edited it and the new version no longer ships it
conflictKind.deletedLocallyChangedRemotely: You deleted it and the new version changed it
conflictKind.unmanagedFileInTheWay: A file that is not part of the modpack is in the way
conflictKind.remanage: The modpack left it alone before and manages it again, but its content is neither the recorded nor the shipped one

toast.loaderPending: The mod loader needs to be installed again. See the downloads page
toast.planChanged: The update plan changed. Choose how to resolve the conflicts again

unlink.confirmBody: The launcher will no longer check this modpack for updates, and no game files are deleted. You can reinstall or republish it to link again.

reason.MODPACK_UPDATE_BOTH_VARIANTS: A file and its .disabled variant both exist. Delete one of them before updating
reason.MODPACK_UPDATE_LINE_GONE: The platform no longer lists this line of the modpack
reason.MODPACK_UPDATE_UNSUPPORTED: This instance has no usable install record or version isolation is off
reason.MODPACK_UPDATE_NOT_ISOLATED: Version isolation is off for this instance, so it cannot be compared safely. Turn it on in the instance settings and retry
reason.MODPACK_UPDATE_BASELINE_MISSING: This instance has no install record for the modpack, or the record is damaged, so it cannot be compared
reason.MODPACK_UPDATE_PACK_UNAVAILABLE: The files of this version are temporarily unavailable on the platform. Try again later
reason.MODPACK_UPDATE_MERGE_INVALID: The selected blocks produce an invalid configuration. Adjust your choices and try again
reason.MODPACK_UPDATE_LOCATE_LOCATING: Could not locate the modpack files. Check your connection and try again.

rollback.hint: You can undo the last modpack update and restore files and loader as they were before it.
